description: This file defines the ORM entity class 'TimesheetItem' for handling timesheet item data within the OrangeHRM system. It includes properties like date, duration, comment, and references to related entities such as Timesheet, Project, ProjectActivity, and Employee. It also contains getter and setter methods for these properties.
